'''Christophe Vandalem''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Liège tournament]] on 7 January 2001 with EBO, according to Julien Riviere's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1604">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-liege-belgium-1-7-2001d1604/ liege-belgium-1-7-2001], DeckTech (Julien "Dark Padawan" Riviere, 8 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-08-liege-belgium-1-7-2001d1604/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
